comment: The spec-driven methodologies the pack can recognize from a repository's own files. Detection PROPOSES — the human confirms; a marker is evidence, never a decision. This file is the only place any methodology is named: adding one is a JSON entry, not a code change, and an entry needs only what can be verified from the adopter's working tree. A methodology absent from this list is still a fully supported path — the adopter answers three questions and the pack follows their instructions.

methodologies.name: DeepWorkPlan
methodologies.notes: The pack renders the adoption directly into its plan anatomy; this entry exists so an installed DWP is detected the same way as any other methodology.

methodologies.name: GitHub Spec Kit
methodologies.notes: Confirm the command with the adopter — Spec Kit's command surface has changed between releases.

methodologies.name: Kiro specs
methodologies.entry_command: (in Kiro) start a new spec session
methodologies.notes: IDE-driven rather than a slash command; hand the bundle as the spec session's input.

methodologies.name: BMAD Method
methodologies.entry_command: (ask the adopter which BMAD agent starts a plan here)
methodologies.notes: Team installs vary; the marker proposes, the adopter names the entry.
